readme_evidence: ### The second brain that lives on your machine — not someone else's cloud.
- **Notes** — Block editor, markdown on disk, backlinks, tags, instant search.
- **Tasks & Projects** — Due dates, priorities, recurrence. CRDT merge, so two devices never clobber each other.
- **Journal** — One file a day. Open in three keystrokes.
- **Calendar** — Time-block your tasks. Drag to reschedule.
- **Canvas** — Infinite board. Draw freehand, then drop real notes, tasks, and events on it as live cards — never copies.
- **AI Agent** — Bring your own model (Claude, Codex, local LLMs). It reads and writes your vault — with an approval step for every write.
- **Sync** — Optional, end-to-end encrypted, multi-device. The server only ever sees ciphertext.
- **Local-first.** Your vault is files on disk. Works offline. Always.

readme_evidence: - **One canvas** - The document and the whiteboard are the same surface. Notes are editable where they sit.
- **Your files** - Markdown in Open Knowledge Format, in a folder you choose. Edits made outside Nodus are picked up; edits made inside are written back.
- **Typst math** - Math renders through Typst compiled to WebAssembly, with no LaTeX toolchain to install.
- **Papers as graphs** - A dropped PDF can become one note or a graph of them: sections along the document outline, bibliography entries as citation notes, each reference
- **Highlights** - Highlights in a dropped PDF become notes, coloured to match and linked to the document they came from.
- **Storylines** - Order a subset of notes into a sequence and read it as a continuous document, or export it as PDF or Typst source.
- **Citations** - Import references from a Zotero library or a BibTeX file, add references to Zotero, and connect papers by who cites whom.
- **Language models** - Local models through Ollama, or a cloud provider. The model works through the same tools you do, and asks before changing the graph.
- **MCP server** - Other AI tools can read and edit the graph over the Model Context Protocol.
- **Local only** - No account, no sync service. The data is on your disk.

readme_evidence: - **打卡：** 员工扫码后输入自己的个人码，点一下签到或签退。
- **今日出勤：** 后台首页直接看到今天谁到了、谁没到、昨天谁忘了签退。
- **补卡和请假：** 点一下就能修改某一天的记录。
- **统计和导出：** 每人的出勤天数、工时、迟到早退次数，可导出给 Excel 算工资。
- **排班（可选）：** 员工提交希望上班的日期，系统自动排出下个月的班表。
- **12 款打卡页面：** 从经典时钟到 3D「小小星球」，每款都有打卡成功动画，后台一键切换。
- **自动备份：** 每天自动备份数据，也可以随时下载一份另存。
- Windows：右键压缩包，选择「全部解压缩」。
- Linux：右键压缩包，选择「解压到此处」。
- **Windows** 提示「Windows 已保护你的电脑」：点「更多信息」，再点「仍要运行」。
- **Mac** 提示无法验证开发者：到「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」点「仍要打开」，再右键程序选择「打开」。
- **严禁通过公网打卡。** 本系统只能在店内或办公室的同一个网络里使用，请不要把它开放到外网（端口映射、内网穿透、放到云服务器等）。
- **管理后台只能在运行程序的这台电脑上打开**，手机和其他电脑只能打卡和报班。
